news.text: #Lazio have asked info for Daniele #Rugani, who can leave #Juventus this summer. #Monza are still interested in #Juve’s centre-back. #transfers[Nico Schira]
#NicoGonzalez is not in #Juventus’ Plans and is waiting for #AtleticoMadrid. Meanwhile the winger has been offered to #Atalanta and #ACMilan by an intermediary. #transfers[Nico Schira]

⚪️⚫️ #Juventus and Milan are in talks today, with close contacts between the two managements: they are studying broader deals, not limited only to #Tomori (a favorite of #Massara) and #Fofana. @cmdotcom[Daniele Longo]

👀❗️"#Milan and #Juventus have come into contact to understand, evaluate and study potential deals until the end of the mercato. It is a mix of agents proposing, intermediaries looking for solutions and the clubs themselves listening. #Fofana's name has been put on the table, along with that of #Tomori, whom the bianconeri already wanted back in January. More clarity will be needed in the coming days."[Fabrizio Romano & Matteo Moretto - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
#Vicario finished his medical examinations about ten minutes ago, tomorrow he will officially be a #Juventus player.[Michele De Blasis]

🗣 John #Elkann to 'Sky Sport': "Objectives? We need to start winning because by winning, more and more important results will arrive both in Italy and in Europe. This year, it will be important to carry out all the commitments we have, keeping in mind that football is made of cycles and today we are in a reconstruction phase, but we also have the awareness that everyone at #Juventus is determined to carry it forward with the goal of bringing this club back to the top".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 John #Elkann to 'Sky Sport': "#Carnevali? Giovanni is a great professional who knows Italian football inside out, right now #Juventus is carrying out a reinforcement process that must start from Italy and respect the club's identity, an identity that blends incredibly well with Giovanni #Carnevali's capabilities and his ambitions, which are the same as the club's, namely to pursue victory".[@juventusinsidernews]
Guglielmo #Vicario is still at the JMedical to undergo his medical examinations which should be over shortly.[Michele De Blasis]

🗣 John #Elkann to 'Sky Sport': "Relationship with #Spalletti? The relationship I have with #Spalletti is a strong one, and the experience of being able to watch him on the bench was something I truly could not refuse. I enjoyed it very much, also because I was able to hear his thoughts firsthand during the course of the match, in addition to the fact that from the bench, you have a completely unique view of the game".[@juventusinsidernews]

👀🎯 "It could be that, linked to some exits, #Juventus could also add a new midfielder like #Fofana from #Milan who is a prominent name and #Kessié also remains on the list.
